hypothesis: Simultaneous, source-balanced training retains target-domain retrieval quality better than CityFlow followed by organizer fine-tuning
initialization: official public DINOv2 ViT-L/14 checkpoint; no prior CityFlow or organizer fine-tune

train_sources.cityflow: official AIC21 Track2 labeled train: 52717 images, 440 IDs, from verified ZIP, no extraction
train_sources.organizer: unchanged organizer train identity fold: 6209 crops, 1001 IDs
train_sources.labels: dataset plus vehicle ID; no ID collision across sources

sampler: per batch 4 CityFlow IDs and 4 organizer IDs, 4 images per ID; camera and CityFlow track aware

optimization.trainable: last four transformer blocks and final norm
optimization.loss: combined ID cross-entropy (label smoothing .1) plus within-source batch-hard metric loss
optimization.augmentation: mild for both sources with matching random erasing

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: best cross-camera organizer dev mAP across 20 epochs, BF16 evaluation
evaluation.method: same cross-camera query/gallery, cosine, paired vehicle-ID bootstrap 5000 draws
evaluation.holdout: excluded; previously used for one-shot E2/refit comparison

storage: best model-only checkpoint, no optimizer state or full archive extraction
release: research-only; no automatic backend or model switch
